BiblicalUsage: Tebeth is the tenth month of the year. Esther was taken to King Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the month is named because the moment mattered: the day Esther went in to the king.
